name: AnythingLLM
tagline: All-in-one desktop AI application with RAG, agents, and vector storage
description: AnythingLLM Desktop is the full-stack AI application that lets you turn documents, PDFs, GitHub repositories, and websites into conversational knowledge bases with zero setup.
features: Complete Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline built-in
Supports LanceDB embedded vector storage with zero cloud dependencies
Multi-modal and web scraping tools for automated agentic workflows
Works with Ollama, LocalAI, vLLM, LMStudio, and commercial APIs

name: Anytype
tagline: Local-first, encrypted knowledge base and operating environment
description: Anytype is an open, private, and peer-to-peer workspace for notes, tasks, documents, and bookmarks. Built on an encrypted local-first graph database with IPFS and p2p sync.
features: Zero-knowledge client-side encryption
Peer-to-peer syncing across devices without centralized servers
Object-based graph architecture connecting notes and ideas
Offline-first with fast local search

name: AppFlowy
tagline: Open-source Notion alternative with local-first privacy and custom plugins
description: AppFlowy is the open-source alternative to Notion that puts you in control of your data. Built with Flutter and Rust, it provides flexible docs, boards, tables, calendars, and offline-first storage.
features: Complete local data ownership — 100% offline functionality
Document editor with rich blocks, callouts, and mathematical formulas
Grid, Kanban board, and Calendar database views
High-performance native Rust core backend

name: AppImageLauncher
tagline: Helper utility to integrate AppImages smoothly into system menus
description: AppImageLauncher makes your Linux desktop AppImage-ready by integrating AppImages seamlessly with your desktop environment. It prompts to move downloaded AppImages to a central directory, generates desktop launcher icons, and simplifies desktop removal.
features: One-click integration dialog upon launching newly downloaded AppImages
Automatic desktop entry creation with icons in GNOME, KDE, and XFCE
Centralized AppImage storage directory management (~/Applications)
Clean uninstallation option directly from the desktop application menu

name: Blender
tagline: Professional 3D creation pipeline for modeling, rigging, and rendering
description: Blender is the world-renowned free and open source 3D pipeline suite. It covers modeling, sculpting, rigging, 3D animation, simulation, GPU raytraced rendering with Cycles, video editing, and 2D storyboard drawing with Grease Pencil.
features: Cycles GPU ray-tracing with OptiX, HIP, and Vulkan backends
Advanced geometry node modeling systems
Grease Pencil 2D illustration and storyboard suite
Full Python 3 API for pipeline scripting and automation

name: Blender LTS (AppImage)
tagline: Community packaged standalone AppImage builds of Blender Long-Term Support
description: Blender LTS AppImage builds by Lethja package the official Linux Long-Term Support (LTS) releases of Blender into portable, self-contained AppImage packages. Includes verified CUDA/OptiX/HIP rendering libraries, Python 3 dependencies, and desktop launcher shortcuts without modifying system packages.
features: Official Blender Long-Term Support branch with guaranteed enterprise stability
Cycles and EEVEE Next rendering backends with hardware raytracing acceleration
Built-in Geometry Nodes procedural modeling and grease pencil tools
Completely self-contained portable package with embedded Python environment
requirements: Linux 64-bit desktop, OpenGL 4.3 or Vulkan GPU, 8GB+ RAM

name: Cemu
tagline: Highly optimized Wii U video game emulator for desktop Linux
description: Cemu is an experimental software to emulate Wii U applications on PC. It allows playing Wii U titles in high resolution (up to 4K and beyond) with graphical enhancements, custom resolution packs, and full controller mapping.
features: Vulkan and OpenGL rendering backend with high-FPS community graphic packs
Support for GamePad screen separation and motion gyro controls
Accurate audio emulation and shader caching for stutter-free gameplay
Custom resolution scaling up to 8K Ultra HD
requirements: Linux 64-bit desktop, Vulkan 1.2 compatible GPU, 8GB RAM

name: Cherry Studio
tagline: Desktop client for multiple AI models supporting DeepSeek, Claude, and GPT
description: Cherry Studio is an open-source desktop AI client supporting multiple LLM providers (DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Ollama) with knowledge bases, prompt templates, and conversation branch management.
features: Direct integration with DeepSeek-R1, OpenAI, Claude 3.5, and local Ollama
Local document knowledge base with vector search
Conversation branching and side-by-side model comparison
Multi-language translation and code execution blocks

name: digiKam
tagline: Professional photo management software designed by photographers
description: digiKam is an advanced digital photo management application for Linux, featuring an intuitive interface that makes importing, organizing, enhancing, searching, and exporting your digital photos effortless. It includes facial recognition, geotagging, raw file processing, and batch workflow tools.
features: Advanced raw camera image processing and color correction
AI facial recognition and automated people tagging
Integrated geolocation editor with interactive map support
High-performance database capable of organizing millions of photos

name: Dolphin Emulator
tagline: High-definition GameCube and Wii console emulator with netplay
description: Dolphin is an emulator for two recent Nintendo video game consoles: the GameCube and the Wii. It allows PC gamers to enjoy games for these two consoles in full HD (1080p) with several enhancements: compatibility with all PC controllers, turbo speed, networked multiplayer, and more.
features: Render classic GameCube and Wii games in pristine 4K resolution
Netplay lobby support for online multiplayer gaming with zero desyncs
Save states, action replay cheat codes, and free-look camera mode
Native support for official Nintendo GameCube controller adapters and Wiimotes
requirements: Linux 64-bit desktop, OpenGL 4.4 or Vulkan GPU

name: DuckStation
tagline: Fast and feature-rich Sony PlayStation 1 (PSX) emulator for Linux
description: DuckStation is a high-performance simulator/emulator of the Sony PlayStation (PSX/PS1) console, focusing on playability, speed, and long-term maintainability with hardware rendering up to 8K.
features: Vulkan, OpenGL, and software hardware-accelerated rendering up to 8K
True-color rendering, widescreen hack, and geometry correction
Internal resolution upscaling from 1x to 16x
Save states, rewind support, and multi-disc chd loading
requirements: x86_64 or aarch64 CPU with SSE4/NEON, Vulkan 1.1+ GPU recommended

name: Flare
tagline: Open-source 2D vector animation successor to Adobe Animate and Flash
description: Flare is an open-source 2D animation suite forked from OpenToonz, designed as a modern community-driven successor to Adobe Animate and Macromedia Flash. It provides vector brush tools, rigging, timeline tweening, raster/vector hybrid workflows, and full Linux desktop export pipelines.
features: Modern 2D vector drawing tools with smoothing and pressure sensitivity
Timeline tweening, keyframing, onion skinning, and frame-by-frame mode
Skeletal rigging and IK (Inverse Kinematics) deformation tools
Export to high-framerate MP4, WebM, APNG, and sprite sheet sequences

name: Godot Engine
tagline: Free, all-in-one, cross-platform 2D and 3D game engine
description: Godot Engine is a feature-packed, cross-platform game engine to create 2D and 3D games from a unified interface. It provides a comprehensive set of common tools, so that users can focus on making games without having to reinvent the wheel.
features: Dedicated 2D pixel-perfect and 3D Vulkan rendering pipelines
Flexible Scene and Node tree architecture
Built-in code editor with GDScript, C#, and C++ bindings
Visual shader editor and real-time animation player

name: Jan
tagline: Open-source local AI conversational assistant that runs 100% offline
description: Jan is an open-source ChatGPT alternative that runs entirely on your local machine with local LLMs (Llama, Mistral, Gemma) or connects to cloud endpoints with full privacy.
features: Runs popular local models like Llama 3, Mistral, and Gemma offline
Built-in model hub with one-click GGUF model downloads
Hardware acceleration via Vulkan, CUDA, and CPU
Local API server compatible with OpenAI protocol (port 1337)
requirements: Linux x86_64, 8GB+ RAM (16GB+ recommended for 7B+ models)

name: KeePassXC
tagline: Secure, cross-platform password manager stored completely offline
description: KeePassXC is a modern, secure, and open-source password manager that stores and manages your most sensitive information offline in an encrypted database using AES-256 and Argon2. You can safely save your logins, credit cards, TOTP 2FA tokens, and private notes.
features: AES-256 and ChaCha20 encryption with Argon2 key derivation
Built-in Time-based One-Time Password (TOTP) authenticator
Native browser integration for Firefox, Chrome, and Brave
Auto-Type login automation on X11 and Wayland

name: KiCad EDA
tagline: Professional schematic capture and PCB layout design software
description: KiCad is an open source suite for Electronic Design Automation (EDA). The programs handle Schematic Capture, and PCB Layout with Gerber output. The suite runs on Windows, Linux and macOS and is licensed under GNU GPL v3.
features: High-resolution schematic capture with electrical rules checking (ERC)
Modern 32-layer PCB layout editor with interactive push-and-shove routing
Integrated 3D raytracing viewer for mechanical fit verification
Extensive official component symbol, footprint, and 3D model libraries

name: Krita
tagline: Professional painting application made by artists for artists
description: Krita is a creative sketching and painting tool designed for concept artists, illustrators, matte and texture artists, and the VFX industry. It features over 100 professionally designed brushes, 9 brush engines, stabilizer support, and seamless wrap-around pattern creation.

Wrap-around tiling mode for game textures and patterns
Full color management with ICC and HDR support
Integrated frame-by-frame animation workspace with audio playback

tagline: Clean, feature-rich office productivity suite for documents and data

It includes Writer (word processor), Calc (spreadsheets), Impress (presentations), Draw (vector graphics), and Math (formulas).

Comprehensive suite: Writer, Calc, Impress, Draw, and Math
Native PDF export with digital signing and form fill support
Extensible with thousands of community templates and plugins

Integrated with AM CLI package manager for one-liner app installations
Automated checksum validation and upstream release mirror verification

name: LocalSend
tagline: Secure, open-source local network file sharing with zero cloud reliance
description: LocalSend is a cross-platform, open-source alternative to Apple AirDrop. Share files, folders, messages, and clipboard data with nearby devices on your local Wi-Fi without internet or third-party servers.

Zero internet connection needed — operates strictly over LAN
Cross-platform discovery for Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux
Send multiple files, entire folders, or plain text messages

Flashcards and spaced repetition built directly into bullet points
PDF annotation and quote referencing tools

Cross-platform netplay with spectator mode and RetroAchievements integration

Direct secure syncing with Signal iOS and Android mobile clients
